stick.gimbal.name: Stick (roll / pitch)
stick.gimbal.note: gimbal under the leather boot on top of the base

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-12), moved from the earlier photo
mappingSource: catalog vpforce.json (sources https://docs.vpforce.eu/rhino/getting-started/, https://docs.vpforce.eu/products/grip-adapters/, https://github.com/walmis/VPforce-TelemFFB): roll = JOY_X, pitch = JOY_Y; VID:PID and HID name read from the user's own Rhino
note: The photo shows the base without a grip, cut out on white (same unit as the cockpit shot, seen from the front left): leather boot and grip connector on top, the two motor covers in front. The gimbal marker sits at the leather boot above the base (the shaft exit). Grip buttons/hats and the other axes depend on the mounted grip and the VPforce Configurator.
